instances.role: P2 lane to / from the DSpark primary (board)
P2 adapter primary lane (TX row 594 2-beat, RX start 101, events), CRED 8
dsfd_coll_p2_ep (mtp-fixlat): grant-protocol end of the P2 die bus; N face = slab N edge (t_p2 / f_p2); a short row above u_pa (its E end meets the slab N edge)
P2 adapter die-B lane (RX lane-1 604 2-beat, DIRECT)

nets.seams: u_cb N <-> u_ce S and u_ce N <-> u_ct S: same-named pins at the same x (abutting, 0-um gap)
nets.lanes: lane k core-face pins <-> the core tile holding lane k (0 / 4: u_cb, 1 2 5 6: u_ce, 3 / 7: u_ct) at slab y = (k % 4) * LH + Y_CORE
nets.clocks: pll_stream -> ck of every lane tile and of u_cb / u_ce / u_ct (die clock tree; core tiles take ck on the W face near mid-height)

cost: full rate; +2..3 cycles per lane/seam crossing each way; full-shape collective bench 3013 cycles vs current 3015, not a token-rate claim
boundary_protocol: lo_r / li_r are credit pulses, not combinational ready; every lane and seam uses an 8-deep credit landing FIFO
